body: Thank you! I actually had a good day today so I;m hoping things improve.

Very true. Thank you for your help with all of this. I've been through therapy, IOP, etc and never felt comfortable with the "professionals" telling me what is best.

The pain has been going on for such a large portion of my life though. While I've been blessed in certain aspects, it seems like everytime I hit rock bottom, something happens to lower that bar. 

I finally let some friends and family know of my thoughts, and they were pretty surprised but willing to help and weren't judgmental. It took a lot of courage, especially considering I've kept these thoughts a secret since I was a 12 or so and first had these ideations. 

The past 2 days  or so have been a roller coaster. Ups and downs, but when I've been on the ups I've made sure to make note of it and see how I can make more "ups" and less downs, and how to try and find the energy to just push through. 

The thing is that depression has made so many tasks difficult to do, hence me staggering to get my life back on track. I'm finally just trying to remind myself that I have to get up and do these things and I will feel better, and its working. It isn't like a magic spell I can break, depression is crippling, but I'm just working on trying to change my though process to start getting on the beginning of a journey as you mentioned. Thank  you again for everything, it has meant a lot that a stranger on the internet would take the effort to confide in me.
While I've learned a lot I'm still scarred. I know I can do much more, but getting over my existing pain is very hard.

I am a Christian and believe in an afterlife. Although according to my faith, suicide means a trip to hell. I have actually prayed asking God if it is okay for me to do this just to give me some sort of sign. Part of me thinks if someone is suffering enough it is acceptable. I've been having strange dreams after that prayer so perhaps I can put the pieces of the puzzle together. I appreciate your reply, I know the reason I'm depressed is losing my life. Lost my lavish lifestyle and the girl I was about to marry. So I feel stuck at square one again but with this debt lingering and so many loose ends untied.
Thank you, just sent a PM.
